condition: If you call .set() on a dayjs.tz() object, the underlying timestamp ends up one hour off, so a.unix() converts back to a different local time than the one shown.
workaround: Build the date in a single step, e.g. dayjs.tz('2024-09-27 03:01:04', 'America/New_York'), instead of chaining .set() calls on a tz object.
